**Comparison of approaches:**

Both traces use identical methodology — a step-by-step simulation of the state machine through all 17 events — and reach the same final answer (State=FAULT, A=false, T=false, n=10, 3 rejections, first at index 2). Neither trace explores alternative branches or considers hypotheticals; both stay linearly grounded in the event log. The key divergence is in verification depth: Trace 1 performs two additional *full* re-runs of the entire simulation ("Final Verification of Steps" and "Let me re-run mentally") plus four separate register-by-register re-traces (A, T, n, State) and a guard-by-guard re-check. Trace 2 performs one full re-run ("Replay Trace") plus a systematic guard re-check. Neither trace's divergences produce any new findings or corrections — they are pure re-execution of already-completed work, confirming the same result each time. No CYCLE or MUSE episodes appear in either trace.
